title: Jelly Roll and Bunnie Xo list $7M Tennessee home after divorce
summary_full: Country singer Jelly Roll, whose real name is Jason DeFord, and Bunnie Xo are selling their Tennessee home. They finalized their divorce settlement earlier this year, transferring ownership of the property to Bunnie Xo. The mansion sits on nearly 10 acres and was built in 2022, with an asking price of around $7 million.
